title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Architect
description: Architect enterprise cloud infrastructure across AWS/Azure, automated CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes microservices, and cybersecurity controls.
details:
### Role Overview
Join an enterprise technology team as a Lead Cloud Architect driving multi-cloud migration, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), and high-availability microservices.

### Key Responsibilities
- Design resilient cloud architectures on AWS/Azure utilizing Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS).
- Establish Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, automated CI/CD pipelines, and Zero-Trust cybersecurity controls.
- Mentor engineering teams, lead architectural reviews, and optimize cloud infrastructure costs.

### Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent.
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
- 7+ years in IT infrastructure engineering, DevOps automation, and cloud architecture.
